role: descriptive cached-clock audit before any further task or controller change
registration_context: positive conditional two-call bound and six component paths observed; adjacent-active-pair counts and nomination-cue coverage totals not yet computed

scope.adjacent_pair: two active calls exactly 60 minutes apart; keep all four observed sign combinations, without constructing new calls
scope.critical_deadline: for a second call at t, the first call's return and tail PN at t-30 is nominated at t-90; that tail is fixed before either first-sign branch in the bound
scope.late_forecast_clock: t-30; its new PN begins at t+30, during the final part of the 32-minute pulse and too late to change earlier stock extrema
scope.early_pairs: if t-90 precedes zero, retain the pair in the sign roster and label its deadline as bootstrap; do not invent a cue
scope.outputs: compact pair rows plus sign-combination totals; deadline-cue absent/present and agreement with each eventual sign; late-cue agreement; whether the selected final first-call source was already received at the deadline
scope.interpretation: agreement is a retrospective descriptive relationship; receipt of a selected source does not guarantee the final mark was known, because later receipts can supersede it

decision: use the observed sequence and information timing to decide whether task-information repair has a factual basis; do not infer a stochastic failure rate or launch another heuristic controller, a larger matrix or a source comparison
limitations: fixed-April descriptive development audit, not a calibrated sign-support model, a 95-percent reliability estimate, a policy feasibility proof or real BM counterfactual dispatch
